subject: SLA reconciliation & credit issuance for Sept 28 incident - SparkFlow
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@sparkflow.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@sparkflow.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Impact on Sept 28 — Request for SLA credits

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the postmortem and the incident timeline you shared this morning. Our production pipelines experienced degraded throughput and several timed-out requests between 22:05 and 23:18 PDT on Sept 28; our monitoring shows elevated error rates during that window. Per our contract (Exhibit B), that window looks eligible for a service credit.

Would Redwood be able to provide the calculation and next steps to receive the credit? We need a formal credit memo for our finance team.

Attachment: customer_monitoring_excerpt_0928.json (json)

Best,
James
James Porter
Head of Platform, SparkFlow
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: James Porter <james.porter@sparkflow.ai>
Cc: seangallagher@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Impact on Sept 28 — Request for SLA credits

Hi James — thanks for flagging this and for sharing the monitoring slice.

Short answer: yes, we will calculate eligibility and, if applicable, issue a credit memo. I’ve looped in Sean (billing) and Evelyn (SRE) to run the eligibility calculation and confirm the outage window against Redwood telemetry. Expect an initial calculation from us within 48 hours and a final credit memo within 5 business days pending approvals.

Next steps I’m coordinating internally:
- Evelyn to reconcile service-side incident windows and quantify impacted tokens/requests.
- Sean to compute dollar-equivalent credit per Exhibit B and prepare a credit memo for signature.
- I’ll follow up with you once those are ready and attach the finalized memo for your finance team.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, seangallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Impact on Sept 28 — Request for SLA credits

Laura / Sean — performed the telemetry reconciliation this morning. Summary:
- Incident time window with customer impact: 22:07:41 - 23:14:52 PDT on 2026-09-28 (internal outage id IO-72).
- Affected requests: 1,384 (requests with error codes or >= 2x latency threshold).
- Estimated affected tokens: 462,000 (approx; derived from request token distribution).
- Notes: Some background retries and client-side mitigation reduced visible failures; we’ve accounted for deduping retries per contract wording.

I attached a calculation worksheet with per-request weighting and token-to-cost mapping. Please validate the cost conversion and the contract baseline used for Exhibit B.

Attachment: sla_calculation_sheet_laura_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

- Evelyn
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: seangallagher@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Impact on Sept 28 — Request for SLA credits

Thanks Evelyn — I reviewed the worksheet and ran the dollar conversion per the contract. Calculation highlights:
- Baseline spend for Aug (used as billing baseline): $42,700
- Monthly uptime target: 99.9%; measured reduction for the billing period attributable to this incident: 0.22%
- Eligible credit (per Exhibit B formula): 0.22% * baseline = $93.94 rounded to $94.
- Per internal policy, we issue a minimum compensatory credit of $250 for incidents generating customer disruption above the threshold; we will honor the higher of calculated vs. policy floor, so credit = $250.

Prepared an official credit memo for SparkFlow (attached). Please confirm from legal if signature is needed, otherwise I’ll route via our billing team to issue as account credit.

Attachment: approved_credit_memo_SF-5342.pdf (pdf)

- Sean Gallagher
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: James Porter <james.porter@sparkflow.ai>, accounts-payable@sparkflow.ai
Cc: seangallagher@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Credit memo for Sept 28 incident (SparkFlow)

Hi James — thank you for your patience. Attached is Redwood’s official credit memo for the Sept 28 incident (incident IO-72). Summary:
- Eligible window: 22:07:41–23:14:52 PDT on 2026-09-28
- Final determination: eligible per contract Exhibit B
- Credit amount: $250 applied as account credit to SparkFlow (SF-5342)

Attachment: approved_credit_memo_SF-5342.pdf (pdf)

Please confirm whether you prefer the credit as an account balance or a refund to the card on file. If you need a signed PDF, let me know and I’ll route for signature.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
